payload.note: F-localization realizes hidden parity exactly on the on-shell orbit of affine backgrounds phi_v and phi_-v. No nonzero localized affine chart is parity fixed, and the v-to-zero multiplier diverges on generic massless packets and on the Jordan jet; hence this completion does not affiliate with the public perturbative vacuum or its q10 coefficient.
